routes.name: VTNZ Wiri - Full Licence Motorway & Highway Circuit
routes.overview: Official Class 1 Full Licence practical test route from VTNZ Wiri, testing high-speed 100 km/h cruising, motorway merging and diverging, lane changing on State Highway 20 (Southwestern Motorway), and verbal hazard identification commentary between Wiri, Māngere East (Massey Road Exit 9), and Papatoetoe.
key_maneuvers: Motorway on-ramp acceleration and merging at 100 km/h onto SH20
Verbal hazard identification commentary (identifying dynamic and stationary hazards out loud)
Multi-lane motorway lane changes at 100 km/h (mirror checks, 3s indicator, blind-spot head check)
Deceleration off-ramp technique and transition from 100 km/h to 60/50 km/h
examiner_tips: Accelerate decisively down the on-ramp so that your vehicle matches the 100 km/h flow of motorway traffic before crossing the broken merge line.
Maintain a minimum 3 to 4-second following distance behind vehicles, particularly heavy commercial trucks common on the Southwestern Motorway.

Call out hazards clearly: describe the hazard, its location, and what you are doing (e.g. "Truck merging from on-ramp ahead on left - checking right mirror, easing off throttle to provide safety gap").
Never brake while still traveling in the high-speed motorway lane; signal left 3 seconds in advance, enter the exit deceleration lane fully, then apply progressive braking.

steps.instruction: Depart VTNZ Wiri testing bay, indicate 3 seconds, check rear-view and wing mirrors, check blind spots.
steps.examiner_focus: Signal for 3 seconds before moving, check all mirrors and physical shoulder blind spot.

steps.instruction: Turn left onto Vogler Drive access road toward Roscommon Road.
steps.examiner_focus: Yield to any oncoming depot vehicles and pedestrians; maintain 20 km/h speed limit.

steps.instruction: Turn left onto Roscommon Road (Route 17) heading north.
steps.examiner_focus: Turn into nearest lane, accelerate smoothly to 60 km/h, check for heavy trucks.

steps.instruction: Continue onto the on-ramp for Southwestern Motorway (SH 20 Northbound toward Airport / Waterview).
steps.examiner_focus: Follow lane markings; begin accelerating decisively down the curved entrance ramp.

steps.instruction: Accelerate purposefully along the on-ramp, building vehicle speed up to 100 km/h.
steps.examiner_focus: Match speed of highway traffic before merging; critical error to impede traffic below speed limit.

steps.instruction: Indicate right for 3 seconds, check center mirror, right wing mirror, shoulder blind-spot check, and merge smoothly onto SH 20.
steps.examiner_focus: Verify safe gap, cancel signal promptly after crossing dashed merge line.

steps.instruction: Cruise on Southwestern Motorway at 100 km/h and commence verbal hazard identification commentary.
steps.examiner_focus: Call out hazards clearly: following distance, traffic joining from on-ramps, overhead signage, braking vehicles.

steps.instruction: Perform lane changes when requested by examiner: signal 3 seconds, mirror check, head check blind spot, move lane smoothly.
steps.examiner_focus: Maintain constant speed while changing lanes; never slow down abruptly during a lane change.

steps.instruction: Indicate left for at least 3 seconds and take Exit 9 off-ramp toward Massey Road (Māngere East).
steps.examiner_focus: Do not brake on the active motorway lane; enter deceleration ramp fully before braking.

steps.instruction: Decelerate smoothly down the ramp from 100 km/h to 50 km/h before the intersection.
steps.examiner_focus: Progressive braking; check rear-view mirror before braking.

steps.instruction: Turn right onto Massey Road (Route 14) and cross the motorway overbridge in the right lane.
steps.examiner_focus: Check pedestrian signals, position car correctly across multi-lane bridge.

steps.instruction: Turn right onto the on-ramp for Southwestern Motorway (SH 20 Southbound toward Manukau / Hamilton).
steps.examiner_focus: Indicate right for 3 seconds, check oncoming traffic and turn cleanly onto entrance ramp.

steps.instruction: Accelerate up to 100 km/h along the southbound on-ramp, signal right for 3 seconds, check blind spots, and merge.
steps.examiner_focus: Confident acceleration to 100 km/h before merging; maintain safe buffer.

steps.instruction: Cruise on SH 20 Southbound at 100 km/h, continuing verbal commentary on roadway conditions and hazards.
steps.examiner_focus: Scan speedometer regularly; ensure speed remains steadily between 95 and 100 km/h without speeding.

steps.instruction: Indicate left for 3 seconds and take the off-ramp toward Cavendish Drive / Roscommon Road (Exit 13).
steps.examiner_focus: Signal early; brake progressively once on exit ramp.

steps.instruction: Follow the connector off-ramp and decelerate to 60 km/h.
steps.examiner_focus: Comply with 60 km/h advisory and regulatory signs.

steps.instruction: Turn right onto Cavendish Drive / Roscommon Road (Route 17 Southbound).
steps.examiner_focus: Select correct lane, check wing mirrors and blind spot before turning.

steps.instruction: Continue straight on Roscommon Road (Route 17), maintaining 60 km/h.
steps.examiner_focus: Scan commercial driveways and pedestrian crossings; check mirrors every 8 seconds.

steps.instruction: Signal right for 3 seconds and turn right into Vogler Drive.
steps.examiner_focus: Give way to oncoming southbound traffic; complete turn into proper lane.

steps.instruction: Turn into VTNZ Wiri testing centre, reverse park into assigned test bay, select Park, and apply handbrake.
steps.examiner_focus: Check 360-degree surroundings before reversing into parking bay; secure vehicle.

routes.name: VTNZ Westgate - Restricted Circuit 1
routes.overview: The official primary Class 1R practical test route covering local suburban streets, right-turns across traffic, and critical multi-lane roundabouts around Westgate / Massey.
key_maneuvers: Parallel park or 3-point turn in residential street
Multi-lane roundabout lane selection and exit indicating
Turning right with and without flush medians
Observing pedestrian crossings and priority give-way rules
examiner_tips: Signal for a full 3 seconds before every lane change or turn.
Complete a clear shoulder head-check into your blind spot before moving.
Do not stop over pedestrian zebra crossings or in yellow marked boxes.
Keep hands placed steadily at the quarter-to-three steering position.

key_maneuvers: Kerbside parallel parking behind target vehicle

routes.name: VTNZ Westgate - Full Licence Motorway & Highway Circuit
routes.overview: The full licence practical test route testing high-speed driving, motorway on-ramp merging, hazard identification and verbal commentary at 80 km/h and 100 km/h around Westgate / Massey.
key_maneuvers: Motorway on-ramp acceleration and 100 km/h merging
Verbal hazard detection: identifying hazards and stating driving actions
Motorway deceleration ramp braking technique
Multi-lane arterial lane changing at 60 - 80 km/h
examiner_tips: In the Full test, you must state what hazards you see AND what you are doing about them (e.g. 'Car reversing from driveway on left - watching for movement and keeping safety buffer').
On the motorway on-ramp, accelerate with conviction so your speed matches highway traffic before you reach the solid line break.
Do not begin braking for an off-ramp until your vehicle is fully inside the deceleration lane.
waypoints: Fred Taylor Dr Continue to follow Rte 32, Westgate / Massey, Auckland

steps.instruction: Depart VTNZ Westgate testing bay, check mirrors, head out toward arterial connector.
steps.examiner_focus: Head check blind spots and commence verbal hazard commentary if requested.

steps.instruction: Turn onto main arterial road toward regional highway / motorway link.
steps.examiner_focus: Maintain smooth acceleration; verify traffic flow in mirrors every 8 seconds.

steps.instruction: Enter highway on-ramp and accelerate to match expressway traffic speed (80 - 100 km/h).
steps.examiner_focus: Indicate for 3 seconds, check wing mirror and over right shoulder before merging into lane gap.

steps.instruction: Maintain 100 km/h cruising speed and demonstrate continuous hazard detection commentary.
steps.examiner_focus: State hazards out loud clearly: road surface, following distance, merging traffic, overhead signs.

steps.instruction: Indicate left for 3 seconds, take motorway exit ramp and smoothly decelerate to 50 km/h.
steps.examiner_focus: Do not brake hard on motorway lane; brake progressively once on deceleration ramp.

steps.instruction: Negotiate arterial multi-lane roundabout and take exit back toward testing centre.
steps.examiner_focus: Correct lane selection early, signal left after passing preceding exit.

steps.instruction: Return into VTNZ Westgate testing station and park vehicle.
steps.examiner_focus: Secure car: place in Park (or Neutral + handbrake), turn off engine.

centers.address: Far North REAP, 33 Puckey Avenue, Kaitaia, Northland 0441
center_tips: Stay in the left lane on the roundabout, and signal once you pass the first exit. On SH1 be prepared for higher speeds - accelerate smoothly to match the flow of traffic.
Maintain appropriate speed for the road conditions – rural roads can have hidden entrances and loose gravel near edges. Use your mirrors regularly to keep aware of any traffic following you.

Listen carefully to each instruction as they test your ability to follow directions and navigate narrow suburban streets. Watch for pedestrians, especially children, and take your time at intersections.

centers.name: VTNZ Cambridge
center_tips: While taking the 1st exit should be straightforward, the preceding streets through Cambridge can be busy. Taylor Street then continues west for over a kilometre – so maintain your speed and lane position.

Cambridge is known for its many roundabouts, so remember to stay calm and treat each one individually. When continuing straight through the 2nd and 3rd roundabouts, no signal is needed on entry – just signal as you exit.
The exit onto Achilles Avenue requires an early signal left on approach. Stay alert – it's easy to become complacent after navigating multiple roundabouts, but the testing officer will be watching.
